title: Ellipsis and Critical Understatement
goal: Deliver measured literary judgements using litotes with no dejar de ser and no dejar de + verb of attention.
grammar: no dejar de ser + noun/adjective and no dejar de + verb of attention for critical litotes

items: I can use no dejar de ser + adjective/noun to deliver measured, understated literary judgements.
I can use no dejar de + verb of attention to highlight conciseness and ellipsis in critical prose.
I can discuss narrative economy and genre (la elipsis, la concisión, verosímil, literario, el género, omitir, condensar).
